title: Quality: 0/10
text:
Quality: 0/10. Cons: Absolutely abysmal quality. I wouldn't pay more than $50 for this cheap junk. Suction is terrible, no foot height adjustment, can't turn off the brush so it wears a nice hole in your floor while you use the hose, hose is too short and not stretchy at all, cord placement is bad and gets in the way constantly, cord is super short, only 1 extender attachment, hand "turbo eraser" attachment gets bogged down by getting anywhere near anything at all, cannister makes no attempt to compress contents so a tiny amount of dog hair fills it immediately you'll empty it many times per use and for the same reason emptying it is an absolute mess, swivel is just a stupid gimick and is only annoying you can't lock it either, the whole thing feels about as solid as my $10 toaster, wheels have a weird wobble on hard floors. I wouldn't even use this as a charitable donation.

Pros: It is technically a vacuum

description: The Bissell Clean View swivel Rewind pet gives a whole new meaning to convenient cleaning. From the second you start using it, you?ll notice its lightweight design and swivel steering work in your favor, giving you easy maneuverability, which makes cleaning quick and less of a chore. Plus, with specialized pet tools stored directly on-board, you can effortlessly switch from cleaning your floors to those above floor spots like blinds, corners and upholstery that easily collect pet hair and dust. Clean view swivel Rewind pet also comes with our innovative multi-cyclonic suction which keeps dirt and debris secure in the dirt tank and away from the filters and motor, so they last longer. Then when it?s time to pack things up, simply press the automatic cord Rewind button and store it away until next time.
